notes: Summary: Pinnacle VectorOps is an enterprise SaaS company building an internal semantic search + retrieval system to power knowledge discovery across customer logs, docs, and call transcripts. They target massive index scale: current production dataset ~250M vectors, expected growth to 1B+ vectors within 12 months. Primary workloads: embeddings generation + dense retrieval + reranking of top-K (K=50) for high-precision results. Key performance targets: p95 latency for reranker <50ms (end-to-end), tail <120ms for large queries; steady-state throughput 2k qps per region; target cost-per-query (embeddings+rerank) <= $0.002, preferred <$0.0015 per query per CTO quote. Technical preferences: 1536-dim embeddings (proprietary embedder + open model fallbacks), quantized reranker (int8) for cost savings, on-GPU KV cache warmup, continuous batching with max latency budget 10ms, and autoscaling with predictable reserved capacity for peak hours. Requirements: VPC/private control plane, KMS integration for key custody, audit logs with 1 year retention, SSO (SAML) + SCIM, EU data residency for EU customers. They require canary rollouts and automatic fallback to hosted smaller variants during capacity pressure. POC scope: ingest a 50M sample, measure end-to-end query cost and p95 latency, validate batching/caching heuristics, demonstrate 3x cost reduction with quantized reranker and smart batching. Milestones: ingest-50m complete (2026-02-05), rerank perf test (2026-03-10) — measured median 28ms, p95 78ms on test cluster; need tuning to hit <50ms p95. Procurement: team prepping Dedicated capacity numbers; procurement schedule targets decision by 2026-06. Quotes from calls: CTO — "We need to prove sub-$0.0015/q at scale or we can't justify Dedicated spend." AE notes: high willingness to commit if SLA, VPC, and measurable unit-cost wins demonstrated. POC deliverables remaining: optimized batching profile, KV cache warm start demo, security evidence bundle for legal.
